regions.name: Kosi
regions.quote: Described from the Kosi/Koshi river, one of the largest tributary systems of the Ganges River which flows down from the Himalayas and through Nepal before joining the Ganges just before it enters Bangladesh.

regions.name: Padma
regions.quote: It's since been recorded from many rivers draining the Himalayan foothills in Nepal and northern India (Gangetic tributaries in Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Bihar and West Bengal states plus tributaries of the Brahmaputra River in West Bengal state), and is also known from the lower Ganges in Bangladesh, where the river is known as the Padma.
